items.title: Stability under specialization is equivalent to being a union of closed subsets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises specialization-stability as being a union of closed subsets (author lemma at source lines 3811-3819, label lemma-stable-specialization). The proof (source lines 3821-3829) uses the preceding lemma for one direction and, for the converse, exhibits a specialization-stable set as the union of the closures of its singletons, which are closed (proof lines 3824-3828). The characterisation is used in the chapter's later discussion of constructible sets and of specialization-stable pieces. H2.
